newsitem.title: USA: Ventana names Pietraszek president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Ventana names Pietraszek president, CEO.

text.p: Ventana Medical Systems Inc said Henry Pietraszek was named president and chief executive officer, as well as a director of the company, effective March 3.
Last November, Ventana began a search for a new president and CEO when it determined that R. James Danehy would not be able to relocate to Tucson. Danehy remains on the company's board of directors.

Pietraszek spent most of his career at Abbott Laboratories Inc, and since leaving that company has served as president and chief executive officer of early stage medical diagnostics company BioStar Inc.
